prompts.title: 奢华产品营销活动网格

prompts.title: 一位手持奢华篮球的女士的电影中景镜头
prompts.description: 生成一张高分辨率电影感中景镜头的提示词：一位红发女性（萨迪·辛克）自信地摆姿，手持一颗镶满水晶的篮球。提示词详细描述了她的高级定制服装（迪奥盾牌眼镜、运动夹克、钻石首饰）、妆容以及专业的竞技场式灯光。
prompts.content: "A high-resolution, cinematic medium shot of a striking woman with vibrant ginger hair styled in a sleek, high ponytail, posing confidently while holding a luxury basketball encrusted with shimmering red, black, and silver crystals. She is wearing futuristic, oversized clear-lens Dior shield glasses with white frames, a white form-fitting zip-up athletic jacket featuring a minimalist black logo on the chest, and layered diamond jewelry including a thick Cuban link necklace and a prominent iced-out watch and ring. Her makeup is polished with soft earth tones and a neutral matte lip, emphasizing her clear complexion and freckles, all captured under bright, professional arena-style lighting that creates sharp details and a high-fashion, sporty aesthetic against a blurred background of a crowd."

prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于生成一张高度逼真的电影感肖像，描绘一位年轻男士身处现代都市街道，强调自然阳光、真实的皮肤纹理、浅景深以及专业的街头摄影美学。
prompts.content:
A highly realistic cinematic portrait of a young man standing outdoors during the daytime in a modern city street. Natural sunlight softly illuminates his face, creating gentle shadows and realistic skin texture with visible pores and fine details. He has slightly messy hair moving naturally in a light breeze and a calm confident expression while looking slightly away from the camera. He is wearing a casual modern outfit, a light jacket over a simple t shirt and dark jeans. The background shows a lively urban environment with buildings, trees, and people walking in the distance, softly blurred with shallow depth of field to keep focus on the subject.

The sunlight creates warm highlights on his hair and shoulders, giving a natural golden tone to the scene. The composition feels like professional street photography taken with a DSLR camera using an 85mm lens. The colors are natural and balanced, with realistic contrast and cinematic color grading.

Ultra photorealistic, cinematic lighting, high dynamic range, sharp focus on the eyes, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field, professional photography, 8k resolution, highly detailed, realistic daylight atmosphere.
prompts.translatedContent:
一位年轻男子在白天站在现代城市街道上的高度逼真的电影感肖像。自然阳光柔和地照亮他的脸庞，营造出柔和的阴影和逼真的皮肤纹理，毛孔和细微之处清晰可见。他略显凌乱的头发在微风中自然摆动，表情平静自信，目光略微偏离镜头。他穿着休闲的现代服装，一件浅色夹克内搭一件简约 T 恤和深色牛仔裤。背景是生动的城市环境，有建筑物、树木和远处行走的人群，通过浅景深柔和虚化，使焦点保持在主体上。

阳光在他的头发和肩膀上形成温暖的高光，为场景带来自然的金色调。构图感觉就像是用数码单反相机搭配 85mm 镜头拍摄的专业街头摄影。色彩自然平衡，对比度逼真，具有电影级的色彩分级。

超逼真、电影级光照、高动态范围、眼睛锐利对焦、自然肤色、浅景深、专业摄影、8k 分辨率、高度细节、逼真的日光氛围。

prompts.title: 身穿比基尼的年轻女性的超逼真自拍
prompts.description: 一个高度详细、照片级的提示，用于生成一张年轻女性身穿比基尼的高角度自拍照，重点突出其面部特征、妆容、发型、服装和室内卧室环境，包括精确的灯光说明和俏皮的表情。
prompts.content:
Photorealistic selfie of a young adult female in her early 20s, shot in a 3:4 aspect ratio from a high-angle, elevated top-down perspective, using a wide-angle front-facing smartphone lens.

She has an oval face with a defined jawline and pointed chin, fair to light tan skin with warm golden undertones, smooth flawless makeup base, and luminous highlighter on cheekbones, tip of the nose, and forehead.

Her eyes are dark brown or hazel, almond shaped, with very long thick black eyelashes (extensions or heavy mascara), subtle dark eyeliner on the upper lash line, and medium-thick arched medium-brown eyebrows.

Her nose has a straight narrow bridge with a slightly rounded tip, subtle contour on the sides, and a bright highlight down the center and tip.

She has prominent high cheekbones with warm rosy-pink blush on the apples of the cheeks blended upward.

Her lips are plump and full with glossy nude-pink tint, showing straight white upper teeth in a wide smile, with a textured pink tongue playfully sticking out over the bottom lip.

Her hair is bright blonde with darker brown roots, straight with slight volume, parted slightly off-center, falling past the shoulders and framing the face.

Expression is joyful, playful, cheeky, relaxed, eyes slightly crinkled from smiling.

She is standing and leaning slightly forward toward the camera, right arm raised making a peace/V sign, left arm extended forward holding the camera, head tilted slightly upward looking at the lens.

She is wearing a two-piece bikini (bikini top and matching bikini bottoms), athletic fit, revealing midriff.

Footwear: white ankle socks with a faint black logo and brown slip-on slide sandals with mirrored white text reading “eòlhC.”

Accessories include small thick gold hoop earrings, a thin gold chain bracelet with small star/clover charms on the right wrist, and neatly filed nails painted pale pink or off-white.

The setting is an indoor bedroom. On the left side, an unmade bed with a light beige fabric base, crumpled white sheets, two stacked white pillows, and a piece of black clothing on the bed.

On the right side, an open bright pink suitcase on the floor containing folded black, white, and blue clothes, the top of an olive green suitcase near the bottom right, and a dark wooden chair or table leg behind the pink suitcase.

The floor is light oak wood laminate with vertical planks.

Lighting comes from bright natural sunlight streaming from the left, creating strong highlights on the face, hair, and shoulders and crisp shadows on the bed, sheets, and floor, indicating a strong direct light source.
prompts.translatedContent:
一位 20 岁出头的年轻女性的逼真自拍，以 3:4 的宽高比，从高角度、俯视的视角，使用广角前置智能手机镜头拍摄。

她拥有椭圆形脸庞，下颌线分明，下巴尖翘，肤色从白皙到浅棕褐色，带有温暖的金色底调，妆容底妆光滑无瑕，颧骨、鼻尖和额头处有明亮的高光。

她的眼睛是深棕色或淡褐色，杏仁状，睫毛非常长而浓密（嫁接或浓密睫毛膏），上眼线有微妙的深色眼线，眉毛中等粗细，呈拱形，中棕色。

她的鼻子鼻梁笔直窄小，鼻尖略圆，鼻翼两侧有微妙的修容，鼻梁中央和鼻尖有明亮的高光。

她颧骨高耸突出，苹果肌上涂有温暖的玫瑰粉色腮红，并向上晕染。

她的嘴唇丰满饱满，涂有光泽的裸粉色唇彩，露出洁白的门牙，笑容灿烂，粉嫩的舌头俏皮地伸出下唇。

她的头发是亮金色，发根颜色较深，直发略带蓬松感，发际线略微偏离中心，垂过肩膀，修饰脸型。

表情愉悦、俏皮、略带顽皮，放松，眼睛因微笑而略微眯起。

她站着，身体略微前倾，面向镜头，右臂举起，做出和平/V 字手势，左臂向前伸出，拿着相机，头部略微向上倾斜，看向镜头。

她穿着两件式比基尼（比基尼上衣和配套比基尼下装），运动剪裁，露出腹部。

鞋子：白色船袜，袜子上有一个淡淡的黑色标志，棕色套穿式拖鞋，上面有镜像的白色文字“eòlhC”。

配饰包括小巧厚实的金色耳环，右手腕上戴着一条带有小星星/三叶草吊坠的细金链手链，指甲修剪整齐，涂有淡粉色或米白色指甲油。

场景是一个室内卧室。左侧是一张未整理的床，床架是浅米色布艺，床单褶皱的白色，两只叠放的白色枕头，床上有一件黑色衣物。

右侧地板上有一个打开的亮粉色行李箱，里面装有折叠好的黑色、白色和蓝色衣物，右下角附近有一个橄榄绿色行李箱的顶部，粉色行李箱后面有一条深色木椅腿或桌腿。

地板是浅橡木纹理的复合地板，垂直铺设。

光线来自左侧射入的明亮自然阳光，在脸部、头发和肩膀上形成强烈的高光，并在床、床单和地板上形成清晰的阴影，表明光源强烈而直接。
